title: BMC response: manpower payments and denial of inflated headline claim
publisher: Free Press Journal, reproducing BMC response
authoredSummary: BMC says due process was followed and INR 33.13 crore paid for manpower, split INR 3.36 crore NSCI and INR 29.77 crore Dahisar; it disputes the political INR 100 crore claim.
limitations: Original BMC release not separately retrieved. This reported total is not reconciled with the prosecution’s different receipt total. Commercial body is not retained; authored summary and retrieval hashes only.
